title: Revisão 9 · Situações Imaginárias & Desejos: If & I Wish

vocab.ex: I failed the test — I wish I had practised harder!
I really wish I had started conversation earlier.

vocab.en: If I knew I couldn't fail
vocab.pt: Se eu soubesse que não poderia falhar
vocab.ex: If I knew I couldn't fail, I would start my own business.

vocab.pt: Eu me mudaria para o exterior
vocab.ex: If I had the chance, I would move abroad.
If I had known you were in town, I would have invited you!
We would have invited you for coffee.
If I hadn't been afraid, I would have learned faster.
You're coming on Saturday night, aren't you?

expressions.example: I really wish I had started practising earlier!

expressions.expr: If I had known..., I would have...
expressions.meaning: Se eu tivesse sabido (no passado)..., eu teria feito...
expressions.example: If I had known you were here, I would have called you.
You have finished all the lessons, haven't you?

sentences: I failed the interview because I didn't prepare. I really wish I had practised harder!
If I knew I couldn't fail, I would start my own international business.
If I had known you were in town last weekend, I would have invited you for coffee!
If I hadn't been so afraid of making mistakes, I would have learned much faster.
You have already finished all 20 lessons of the course, haven't you?
You're coming to the farewell dinner on Saturday night, aren't you?

grammar.title: Desejos (Wish), Situações Imaginárias (If) e Confirmações
rules: Para arrependimentos sobre o passado, usamos WISH + HAD + 3ª forma: "I wish I had practised harder".
Para imaginar algo hoje: "If I knew / If I had..., I would + ação" (If I knew I couldn't fail, I would start...).
Para imaginar um passado diferente: "If I had known..., I would have + 3ª forma" (I would have invited you).
Para confirmar no final da frase, espelhamos o auxiliar: "You have finished..., haven't you?" / "You're coming..., aren't you?".

rows: I wish I had started earlier.
If I knew, I would tell you.
If I had known, I would have invited you.
